dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Now that I think about it, every time I saw Sandrone, the notebook she had with her was never exactly the same... Probably because she was someone who loved taking notes and often had new ideas.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Though she is a machine, to you and your companions, Sandrone is entirely human. Her joys, sorrows, and emotions are not much different from yours...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The notebook that The Knave hands you is somewhat aged, with creases at the corners, as if it had been accidentally folded and then carefully smoothed out by someone.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Sandrone has a lot of stories about her recorded in it. You're not sure if The Knave has read them.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But judging from the expression on her face when she gave you the notebook... she seems to know Sandrone very well even without it, and is even responsible for carrying out her "last wishes.")
